clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Gnoarn helps his scattered people find aid. The exiled gnome lives in Tinker Town after the fall of Gnomeregan, directing travelers to fellow engineers and survivors.

Gnoarn keeps track of Gnomeregan's scattered survivors from Tinker Town in Ironforge. Troggs invaded the great underground city, and catastrophic radiation made it uninhabitable. The Bronzebeard dwarves gave Gnoarn refuge, as they did many of his people. He now points capable travelers toward gnomes who need help abroad, including the stranded pilot Bingles Blastenheimer in Loch Modan and the ambitious engineer Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.
